results.rationale: Leaves, water background and stem placement remain consistent. The bud opens into widely spread pale petals with a yellow center, but the inner petals still cup upward and distinct yellow stamens are weakly resolved. The flower is coherent with slightly smooth, synthetic-looking petal surfaces.

The original large port stays large while an extra large port is added; it is not reduced to the small port size. Labels and original port positions shift, and extra brackets appear. The adapter is cleanly rendered and text is legible, though the dangling lower bracket arrangement is awkward.
